calculation_steps: Construct exact oriented D_k and K_k=D_k-D_k^T, verify K_iK_j=0 for i!=j and K_i³=-4 K_i.
With P_i=-K_i²/4, expand U(t)=I+sum[sin(2g_i t) K_i/2+(cos(2g_i t)-1)P_i].
For ecell, K3 ecell=sum_j (-1)^j e_face_j and P3 ecell=ecell; all other K_i annihilate ecell. Thus top-cell readout has only top and face modes, no edges/vertices at all t.
For G_epsilon=G+epsilon B with only (f0,c) bond, the edge/cell coefficient of G_epsilon² is epsilon*g2*D2(edge,f0); t² term is one-half this coefficient.
Since B breaks signed S4 and generally [G_epsilon,J]!=0, previous phase certificate is not inherited.
A conventional 15-port system with same G and readout gives same U(t) for all time; no UD-specific physical mechanism identified.
